svg.text: TWO-TRAIN FUNGAL SOLIDS PLANT · CONTAINMENT & PROCESS ARRANGEMENT
CONTAINMENT SHELL · NEGATIVE PRESSURE · GOWNED ENTRY ONLY
AIR GAP — NO PIPE, NO DUCT, NO FITTING, NO SHARED AIR HANDLING
A VALVE CAN BE OPENED. A GAP CANNOT. THIS IS THE DESIGN.
PLANT ENVELOPE 14.5 m · SERVES A SETTLEMENT OF 24 AT ONE BLOCK PER DAY
SHELL HELD AT −25 Pa RELATIVE TO HABITAT
ALL AIR LEAVES THROUGH FILTERS. NONE RETURNS UNFILTERED. AIR ALWAYS FLOWS INWARD AT THE DOOR.
RESIDUAL HAZARD: A FUNGUS IS BEING CULTIVATED INSIDE THE ONLY ATMOSPHERE THE SETTLEMENT HAS.
CONTAINMENT IS THE GATING UNKNOWN — SEE §5 AND §6 PHASE B OF THE CONCEPT STUDY.
CARBON NOTE: WHITE ROT MINERALISES SOLID CARBON TO CO2. THIS PLANT IS A NODE IN THE CARBON LOOP, NOT A SINK.
FIG. B — LIFE OF ONE BLOCK
SLOW ON PURPOSE — SEE DETAIL A.
